<script src="https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.6.0/jquery.min.js"></script>
<script>
    var selectCheckFunction = selectCheckFunction || {};
    (function(_) {
        const target = '.js-searchContents';

        const target02 = ".js-countdown-loop";

        const target03 = '.js-widget-popup';
        let shadeEl = {};
        const popupSetting = {
            modal: false,
            shade: true
        };

        _.checkSelect = function(el) {
            let items = el.querySelectorAll('.js-item input');
            let catArr = [];
            let baseInCheckbox, resultInCheckbox, checkBlink;
            let flag = false;

            let resultNum = el.querySelector('.js-resultNum');
            let numWrite = resultNum.querySelector('.js-num');
            let totalContent = el.querySelectorAll('.js-resultContent');
            numWrite.innerHTML = totalContent.length;
            let searchResultArea = el.querySelector('.searchResult__area');
            let answerArea = el.querySelector('.js-answer')

            let questionBox = el.querySelector('.js-question');
            let selectCheckBox = el.querySelector('.js-selectCheck');
            let searchBtn = el.querySelector('.js-searchBtn');

            for (const item of items) {
                let input = item;
                let resultContents = el.querySelectorAll('.js-resultContent');

                resultContents.forEach(function(initContent) {
                    let cats = initContent.dataset.result;

                    if (catArr.length === 0 && initContent.classList.contains("fadeOut")) {
                        initContent.classList.remove("is-hidden");
                        initContent.classList.remove("fadeOut");
                    }
                });

                let checkItems = el.querySelectorAll('.js-item');
                checkItems.forEach(function(item) {
                    if (item.querySelector('input:checked')) {
                        let checkedItem = item.querySelector('input:checked')
                        writeAnswer(questionBox, checkedItem.name, checkedItem.value);
                        writeAnswer(selectCheckBox, checkedItem.name, checkedItem.value);
                    }
                })

                searchBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    if (!flag && searchResultArea.classList.contains('is-hidden') && answerArea.classList.contains('is-hidden')) {
                        searchResultArea.classList.remove('is-hidden');
                        answerArea.classList.remove('is-hidden');
                    }
                })


                item.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    flag = true;
                    let cat;
                    cat = input.id;

                    if (input.type === 'checkbox') {
                        if (input.checked) {
                            catArr.push(cat);
                        } else {
                            let index01 = catArr.indexOf(cat);
                            catArr.splice(index01, 1);
                        }
                    } else if (input.type === 'radio') {
                        arrCheckFilter(cat, 3)
                    }

                    function arrCheckFilter(el, num) {
                        let catGroup = el.slice(0, num);
                        let reg = new RegExp(catGroup);
                        let arrCheck = catArr.filter(v => v.match(reg));

                        if (arrCheck == '') {
                            catArr.push(cat);
                        } else {
                            let index02 = arrCheck.join();
                            catArr = catArr.filter(function(a) {
                                return a !== index02;
                            })
                            catArr.push(cat);
                        }
                    }

                    writeAnswer(questionBox, item.name, item.value);
                    checkBlink = questionBox.querySelector('.is-check');
                    checkBlink.classList.remove('is-check');
                    el.querySelector('[data-write="' + item.name + '"]').parentNode.classList.add('is-check')

                    resultContents.forEach(function(resultContent) {
                        let cats = resultContent.dataset.result;

                        const resultCatArr = cats.replace(/\s+/g, "").split(",");
                        const isIncludedCat = catArr.filter(function(catResult) {
                            return resultCatArr.indexOf(catResult) != -1;
                        });

                        let baseArr = resultCatArr.filter(value => value.match(/^r/g));
                        let resultArr = isIncludedCat.filter(value => value.match(/^r/g));

                        baseInCheckbox = resultCatArr.filter(value => value.match(/^c/g));
                        resultInCheckbox = catArr.filter(value => value.match(/^c/g));

                        if (catArr.length === 0) {
                            if (!resultContent.classList.contains("is-count")) {
                                resultContent.classList.add("is-count");
                            }
                        } else if (input.type == 'radio') {
                            if (!el.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]:checked')) {
                                if (getAllDuplicate(resultCatArr, catArr)) {
                                    resultContent.classList.add("is-count");
                                } else {
                                    resultContent.classList.remove("is-count");
                                }
                            } else {
                                if (JSON.stringify(baseArr) === JSON.stringify(resultArr) && getAllDuplicate(resultInCheckbox, baseInCheckbox)) {
                                    resultContent.classList.add("is-count");
                                } else {
                                    if (getAllDuplicate(resultCatArr, catArr)) {
                                        resultContent.classList.add("is-count");
                                    } else {
                                        resultContent.classList.remove("is-count");
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                        } else if (input.type == 'checkbox') {
                            if (!el.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked')) {
                                if (getAllDuplicate(isIncludedCat, catArr)) {
                                    resultContent.classList.add("is-count");
                                } else {
                                    resultContent.classList.remove("is-count");
                                }
                            } else {
                                if (getAllDuplicate(resultCatArr, catArr)) {
                                    resultContent.classList.add("is-count");
                                } else {
                                    resultContent.classList.remove("is-count");
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        let resultDiff;
                        if (catArr.length === 0) {
                            resultDiff = resultContents.length;
                        } else {
                            let resultContentHidden = el.querySelectorAll('.js-resultContent.is-count');
                            resultDiff = resultContents.length - (resultContents.length - resultContentHidden.length);
                        }


                        searchBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                            numWrite.innerHTML = resultDiff;
                            writeAnswer(selectCheckBox, item.name, item.value);
                            if (catArr.length === 0) {

                                if (!resultContent.classList.contains("is-active")) {
                                    resultContent.classList.add("is-active");
                                }

                                if (resultContent.classList.contains("fadeOut")) {
                                    resultContent.classList.remove("is-hidden");
                                    resultContent.classList.remove("fadeOut");
                                }
                            } else {
                                if (resultContent.classList.contains('is-count')) {
                                    if (!resultContent.classList.contains("is-active")) {
                                        resultContent.classList.add("is-active");
                                        resultContent.classList.remove("is-hidden");
                                        resultContent.classList.remove("fadeOut");
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    resultContent.classList.remove("is-active");
                                    if (!resultContent.classList.contains("fadeOut")) {
                                        resultContent.classList.add("fadeOut");
                                        setTimeout(() => {
                                            resultContent.classList.add("is-hidden");
                                        }, 500);
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            if (searchResultArea.classList.contains('is-hidden') || answerArea.classList.contains('is-hidden')) {
                                searchResultArea.classList.remove('is-hidden');
                                answerArea.classList.remove('is-hidden');
                            }
                        }, false);

                        function getIsDuplicate(arr1, arr2) {
                            return [...arr1, ...arr2].filter(item => arr1.includes(item) && arr2.includes(item)).length > 0
                        }

                        function getAllDuplicate(arr1, arr2) {
                            return arr2.every(item => arr1.indexOf(item) != -1)
                        }
                    });
                }, false);

                function writeAnswer(el, itemName, itemValue) {
                    let whiteBox = el.querySelector('[data-write=' + itemName + ']');
                    whiteBox.innerHTML = itemValue;
                }
            }
        }

        _.CountdownTimer = class Countdown {

            static defaultSetting = {
                /* 出力先class */
                view: {
                    d: '.js-cd-d', //日
                    hr: '.js-cd-hr', //時間
                    min: '.js-cd-min', //分
                    sec: '.js-cd-sec', //秒
                    ms: '.js-cd-ms' //ミリ秒
                },
                /* 0になった桁の出力先親要素を自動削除 */
                digitHide: false,
                /* 自動起動 */
                startup: true,
                /* カスタム表示更新関数 */
                customView: null,
                /* カウントダウン終了時コールバック */
                callback: null
            };

            constructor(element, lasttime, option) {
                const setting = this.getExtendSetting(option);
                this.key = ['d', 'hr', 'min', 'sec', 'ms'];
                this.timer;
                this.el = element;
                this.end = typeof lasttime === 'string' ? new Date(lasttime.replace(/-/g, "/")) : lasttime;
                this.view = setting.view ? {} : null;
                for (let key in setting.view) {
                    if (this.el.querySelector(setting.view[key])) {
                        this.view[key] = this.el.querySelector(setting.view[key]);
                    } else {
                        this.key = this.key.filter(item => item !== key);
                    }
                }

                this.digitHide = setting.digitHide;
                this.customView = setting.customView;
                this.callback = setting.callback;

                if (setting.startup) {
                    this.countdown();
                }
            }

            getExtendSetting(option) {
                let defaultSetting = Object.assign({}, this.constructor.defaultSetting)
                let extendSetting = Object.assign({}, option)
                return Object.assign(defaultSetting, extendSetting);
            }

            get state() {
                let current = new Date();
                return this.end - current > 0 ? true : false;
            }

            get count() {
                let count = {};
                let current = new Date();
                let end = this.end;
                let diff = end - current;
                count.d = Math.floor(diff / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                count.hr = this.key.includes('d') ?
                    Math.floor((diff % (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) / (60 * 60 * 1000)) :
                    Math.floor((count.d * 24) + (diff % (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) / (60 * 60 * 1000));
                count.min = Math.floor((diff % (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) / (60 * 1000)) % 60;
                count.sec = Math.floor((diff % (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) / 1000) % 60 % 60;
                count.ms = Math.floor((diff % (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) / 10) % 100;

                if (!(this.state)) {
                    for (let key of ['d', 'hr', 'min', 'sec', 'ms']) {
                        count[key] = 0;
                    }
                }
                return count;
            }

            set count(lasttime) {
                this.end = typeof lasttime === 'string' ? new Date(lasttime.replace(/-/g, "/")) : lasttime;
            }

            addZero(num) {
                return ('0' + num).slice(-2);
            }

            updateView(count) {
                let removeFlg = true;
                for (let key of this.key) {
                    if (key === 'd' || (key === 'hr' && count[key] > 9)) {
                        this.view[key].innerHTML = count[key];
                    } else {
                        this.view[key].innerHTML = this.addZero(count[key]);
                    }

                    if (this.digitHide && removeFlg && count[key] === 0 && this.key[this.key.length - 1] !== key) {
                        this.view[key].parentNode.style.display = 'none';
                    } else {
                        if (this.view[key].parentNode.style.display == 'none') {
                            this.view[key].parentNode.style.display = '';
                        }
                        removeFlg = false;
                    }
                }
            }

            countdown() {
                this.timer = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    if (this.customView) {
                        this.customView(this.count);
                    } else if (Object.keys(this.key).length) {
                        this.updateView(this.count);
                    }

                    if (this.state) {
                        this.countdown();
                    } else {
                        window.cancelAnimationFrame(this.timer);
                        if (this.callback) this.callback();
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        _.countdownTimerLoop = function(el) {
            const option = getOption(el);
            option.today = typeof option.today === 'string' ? option.today.split(':') : option.today;
            let current = new Date();
            let end = new Date(current.getFullYear(), current.getMonth(), current.getDate(), option.today[0], option.today[1], option.today[2]);
            if (current > end) {
                end.setDate(end.getDate() + 1);
            }
            let timer = new _.CountdownTimer(el, end, {
                callback: function() {
                    timer.count = end.setDate(end.getDate() + 1);
                    timer.countdown();
                }
            });
        }

        function getOption(el) {
            let setting = {
                today: el.querySelector('.countdown').dataset.setting
            }
            let option = Object.assign({}, setting);
            let dataset = Object.assign({}, el.dataset)
            return Object.assign(option, dataset);
        }

            if (option[Symbol.toStringTag] === 'DOMStringMap') {
                option = Object.fromEntries(
                    Object.entries(option)

            return Object.assign({}, defaults, option);

        function convertData(data) {
            if (data === "true") return true;
            if (data === "false") return false;
            if (data === "null") return null;
            if (data === +data + "") return +data;
            if (/^(?:\{[\w\W]*\}|\[[\w\W]*\])$/.test(data)) return JSON.parse(data);
            return data;

            return el.animate({

            }, {
                duration: 300,
                fill: "forwards"
            })
        }

        function fadeOut(el) {
            return el.animate({
                opacity: [1, 0]
            }, {
                duration: 300,
                fill: "forwards"
            })
        }

            document.querySelector('html').style.overflow = 'hidden';
            const el = document.getElementById(id) || document.querySelector(target);
            const option = getPopupOption(el.dataset, popupSetting);
            if (elName) {

                if (!option.modal) shade.addEventListener('click', () => _.close(id));
                shadeEl[id] = document.body.appendChild(shade);
            }
            el.classList.add('active');
            fadeIn(shadeEl[id]);
            fadeIn(el);
        };

            document.querySelector('html').style.overflow = '';
            const el = document.getElementById(id) || document.querySelector(target);
            const option = getPopupOption(el.dataset, popupSetting);

            object = Array.from(object).filter((img) => {

            if (typeof LazyLoad === 'undefined' || !(object.length)) {
                if (!callback) return;

                return;
            }
            let preload = 'lazypreload-';
            let n = 0;
            while (document.querySelector('.' + preload + n)) n++;
            Array.from(object, el => {

                el.classList.remove('lazyload');
            });
            lazyLoadInstance.update();

            const lazyPreloadInstance = new LazyLoad({
                elements_selector: '.' + preload + n,
                callback_loaded: function(element) {
                    element.classList.remove(preload + n);
                },
                callback_finish: function() {
                    if (!callback) return;
                    callback();
                }
            });
            lazyPreloadInstance.loadAll();
        };

                        behavior: "smooth",
                        block: 'center'
                    });
                    _.fadeIn(contents, settings.messageSpeed.fadeIn);
                    if (selectedIndex) contents.dataset.selected = selectedIndex;
                }
            }
        }
        _.clickChoice = function(el) {
            const choices = el.querySelectorAll('.choices');
            const answerBox = el.querySelectorAll('.answer-box');
            choices.forEach((choice, choiceIndex) => {
                if (choice.classList.contains('active')) {
                    choice.classList.remove('active');
                }
                const choiceItem = choice.querySelectorAll('.choices-item');
                const baseNum = choice.dataset.total ? parseInt(choice.dataset.total, 10) : Math.floor(Math.random() * (10000 - 1000 + 1)) + 1000;
                let getPercent;
                if (choice.dataset.min || choice.dataset.max) {
                    getPercent = {
                        min: choice.dataset.min ? choice.dataset.min : settings.percentage.min,
                        max: choice.dataset.min ? choice.dataset.max : settings.percentage.max,
                    };
                }
                const minPercent = _.toHalfWidth((getPercent ? getPercent.min : settings.percentage.min).toString());
                const maxPercent = _.toHalfWidth((getPercent ? getPercent.max : settings.percentage.max).toString());
                const randomNumbers = _.getRandomNum(baseNum, choiceItem.length, parseFloat(minPercent), parseFloat(maxPercent));
                choiceItem.forEach((item, i) => {
                    const progress = item.querySelector('.progress');
                    const totalEl = item.querySelector('.total');
                    const rateEl = item.querySelector('.rate');
                    if (progress) {
                        const predefinedNum = parseInt(progress.querySelector('[data-num]').dataset.num, 10);
                        if (!isNaN(predefinedNum) && predefinedNum > 0) {
                            const actualNum = Math.floor(baseNum * (predefinedNum / 100));
                            const rate = ((actualNum / baseNum) * 100).toFixed(1);
                            progress.querySelector('[data-num]').dataset.num = actualNum;
                            progress.querySelector('[data-num]').style.width = `${rate}%`;
                            totalEl.dataset.num = actualNum;
                            rateEl.dataset.num = `${rate}%`;
                        } else {
                            const rate = ((randomNumbers[i] / baseNum) * 100).toFixed(1);
                            progress.querySelector('[data-num]').dataset.num = randomNumbers[i];
                            progress.querySelector('[data-num]').style.width = `${rate}%`;
                            totalEl.dataset.num = randomNumbers[i];
                            rateEl.dataset.num = `${rate}%`;
                        }
                    }
                });

                function handleChoiceSelection(item, parent, choiceItem, i) {
                    if (item.querySelector('input').disabled) {
                        return;
                    }
                    parent.classList.add('active');
                    let totalPoll = false;
                    const nextItem = choice.nextElementSibling;
                    if (nextItem && nextItem.classList.contains('total-poll')) {
                        totalPoll = true;
                    }

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        choice.scrollIntoView({
                            behavior: "smooth",
                            block: 'center',
                        });
                        if (totalPoll) nextItem.innerHTML = `投票数合計 ${baseNum}`;
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            _.nextShow(parent.closest('.auto-chat-contents'), (i + 1));
                        }, settings.messageSpeed.delay * 1.5);
                    }, (settings.messageSpeed.delay / 3));
                }
                choiceItem.forEach((item, i) => {
                    if (item.querySelector('input[type="radio"]')) {
                        item.addEventListener('click', () => {
                            handleChoiceSelection(item, choice, choiceItem, i);
                        });
                    }
                    if (item.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]')) {
                        let btn = answerBox[choiceIndex].querySelector('.select-show-btn');
                        if (!btn) {
                            btn = document.createElement('div');
                            btn.classList.add('select-show-btn');
                            btn.innerHTML = '選択完了';
                            answerBox[choiceIndex].appendChild(btn);
                        }
                        item.addEventListener('click', () => {
                            const checkedItems = Array.from(choiceItem).filter(ci => ci.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]').checked);
                            if (checkedItems.length > 0) {
                                btn.classList.add('active');
                            } else {
                                btn.classList.remove('active');
                            }
                        });
                        btn.addEventListener('click', () => handleChoiceSelection(item, choice, choiceItem, 99));
                    }
                });

            });
        }
        _.nextBtn = function(el) {
            const nextEl = el.querySelectorAll('.auto-chat-next');
            nextEl.forEach((next) => {
                const nextBtn = next.querySelector('.btn');
                const support = next.closest('.auto-chat-support');
                if (nextBtn) {
                    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        const selectedIndex = next.dataset.selected ? next.dataset.selected : null;
                        let item = nextBtn.closest('.auto-chat-next');
                        let clonedSupport;
                        if (support) {

                            item = nextBtn.closest('.auto-chat-support');
                        }
                        _.nextShow(item, selectedIndex);
                        nextBtn.classList.add('disabled');
                    });
                }
            });
        }
        _.creatSupport = function(el) {
            const support = el.querySelector('.auto-chat-support');
            supportClone = support.cloneNode(true);
            supportClone.querySelector('.auto-chat-contents').children[0].remove();
        }
        let cloneIndex = 1;
        _.cloneSupport = function(support) {
            const clonedSupport = supportClone.cloneNode(true);
            clonedSupport.querySelectorAll('.choices-item').forEach((item, index) => {
                item.querySelector('input').setAttribute('name', `support-${cloneIndex}`);
                item.querySelector('input').setAttribute('id', `support-${cloneIndex}-${index}`);
                item.querySelector('label').setAttribute('for', `support-${cloneIndex}-${index}`);
            });
            cloneIndex++;
            support.parentNode.insertBefore(clonedSupport, support.nextSibling);
            _.clickChoice(clonedSupport);
            _.nextBtn(clonedSupport);
            return clonedSupport;
        }
        _.init = function() {
            Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(target), el => {
                _.hideItems(el);
                _.setInputtags(el);
                _.greetingShow(el);
                _.clickChoice(el);
                _.nextBtn(el);
                _.creatSupport(el);
            });
        };
    })(sbAutoAnswerChatSelection);
</script>
